targetWork.author: Michael A. Jalandoon
targetWork.title: Heavy metals and physicochemical assessment of water, sediments and Oreochromis niloticus (Tilapia) in Maragondon River, Philippines

method: Reviewed official AEA-IRC/DLSU-D library and access-policy pages and targeted public web-index searches. The institution routes users to its OPAC, but a record-specific catalog search was not completed and no thesis text was accessed.

institutionalSources.finding: DLSU-D AEA-IRC describes its Archives and Special Collection as maintaining the DLSU-D Access to Institutional Repository for digitized theses, dissertations and university publications.

The current online-services FAQ says A.I.R. is temporarily suspended due to technical issues, points users to the OPAC, and states full-text thesis access requires proof of author permission; requests may be for a full text or author-approved pages.
Official DLSU-D library contact and service page.

searchOutcome.reason: The public institutional route identifies the catalog and collection but no record-level thesis detail was retrieved in this review. Repository suspension and authorization requirements are access limits, not evidence that the thesis or its claims are absent.

decision.reason: The institutional access policy does not expose the target thesis content or authorize redistribution. Keep the Oreochromis niloticus specimen claim held until the thesis protocol/voucher evidence and item-specific reuse permission can be checked.

nextAction: Search the DLSU-D OPAC by the exact thesis title and author; if the work is held, request metadata/abstract and ask what author permission is required for full-text review. Do not reuse thesis-derived tables or species claims without explicit rights and independent taxonomic support.
